general.title: General
general.featurePreviewDesc: Enable experimental features. These may be unstable or change without notice.
general.searchSensitivityDesc: Controls how strict or loose fuzzy search matching is
general.hotkeyDesc: Press a key combination to set your global shortcut
general.followSystemAppearanceDesc: Match the light or dark appearance of your system.
general.startupDesc: Choose how Volt fits into your everyday workflow.
general.closeOnLaunchDesc: Hide the launcher after opening a result.
general.searchPreferencesDesc: Tune search results and your launcher shortcut.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Choose how explicit web searches behave and which installed browser opens HTTP and HTTPS links.
webSearch.defaultEngineDesc: Used for ?, web, search, and chercher queries. Engine-specific keywords still take priority.
webSearch.browserDesc: Only browsers detected among your installed applications are shown.
webSearch.rememberHistoryDesc: Opt in to local suggestions from your previous explicit web searches.
webSearch.securityNotice: Volt validates the selected browser and only opens HTTP or HTTPS URLs. If that browser is removed, Volt automatically returns to the system browser.
webSearch.clearHistoryDesc: Delete the web queries remembered on this device.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.hiddenCount_one: {{count}} more app hidden. Use search to narrow the list.
shortcuts.hiddenCount_other: {{count}} more apps hidden. Use search to narrow the list.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.showOnScreenDesc: Choose which screen Volt appears on when toggled
advanced.maxResultsDesc: Maximum number of search results displayed
advanced.windowEffectDesc: Volt glass (default), native Windows backdrop, or solid
advanced.transparencyDesc: Adjust glass tint and inner surfaces (50%–100%)
advanced.transparencySolidHint: Disabled in solid mode — switch to Volt Glass, Mica or Acrylic

about.title: About
about.description: Fast, beautiful desktop launcher for Windows, macOS, and Linux
about.builtWith: Built with Tauri, React, and Rust
about.packageManagerManaged: Updates are managed by your operating-system package manager.
about.microsoftStoreManaged: Updates are delivered by the Microsoft Store.
about.deferralReady: Update ready — will install on next restart
about.criticalUpdate: Critical security update — please install immediately
about.reportIssueDesc: Tell us about a bug or suggest an improvement.
about.autoCheckDesc: Look for a new version in the background and notify you. Nothing is installed without your confirmation.
about.channelDesc: Beta builds arrive earlier and may be less stable.
about.checkDesc: Look for a new version now and install it.
about.openLogsDesc: Show the folder that holds the Volt log files.
about.copyDiagnosticsDesc: Copy version, system and log location details to share when you ask for support.
about.backupDesc: Move your settings to another computer or keep a copy.
about.exportDesc: Save your settings to a JSON file.
about.importDesc: Replace your settings with the content of a JSON file.

fileSearch.title: File Search
fileSearch.respectIgnoreFilesDesc: Apply .gitignore, .ignore and .voltignore rules from folders and their parents.
fileSearch.excludeGeneratedDirsDesc: Skip known dependency and build caches. Manual exclusions still take priority.
fileSearch.diagnosticsEnabledDesc: Keep counts and durations for the last 50 scans for the local report. No paths recorded.
fileSearch.reportDesc: The last 50 scans: durations and counters, without file paths. Nothing is sent automatically.
fileSearch.indexOnStartupDesc: Automatically index files when Volt starts
fileSearch.staleThresholdDesc: Re-scan on launch when the index is older than this (covers changes made while Volt was closed)
fileSearch.foldersToIndexDesc: Directories to scan for files (e.g., Documents, Downloads)
fileSearch.excludedPathsDesc: Paths or folders to skip during indexing
fileSearch.indexStatusDesc: Persistent SQLite index statistics and maintenance
fileSearch.statsLoadFailedDesc: The index status could not be loaded. Try again to check its state.
fileSearch.statsRefreshFailedDesc: The latest index status could not be loaded. Previously loaded values are shown below and may be out of date.

stats.rebuildDesc: Clears the database and re-scans all configured folders from scratch

fileSearch.deepSearchDesc: Search up to 10 levels inside indexed folders, instead of 3 by default.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.builtinDesc: Turn the tools of the launcher on or off. A disabled tool no longer answers in the search bar.
plugins.enableDesc: Turn this tool on or off in the launcher. Changes apply once saved.

descriptions.calculator: Evaluate math, unit conversions, dates and time zones as you type.
descriptions.websearch: Search the web with ? or an engine keyword, with optional live suggestions.
descriptions.systemcommands: Open Settings, reload or quit Volt from the launcher.
descriptions.timer: Countdown timers and a Pomodoro with a task list.
descriptions.system_monitor: Live CPU, memory, disk, network and process metrics.
descriptions.games: Find and launch installed games from every detected store.
descriptions.clipboard: Browse and reuse your clipboard history.
descriptions.emoji-picker: Pick emoji and symbols with : or the emoji keyword.
descriptions.notes: Create, search and open Markdown notes stored on this device.
descriptions.snippets: Expand ;triggers into reusable text from the search bar.
descriptions.shellcommand: Run shell commands from the launcher with the > prefix.
descriptions.quicklinks: Open saved URLs, folders and commands with a short keyword (ql).
descriptions.window-management: Snap and arrange windows with keyboard commands.
descriptions.developer-tools: Quick developer utilities such as UUIDs and hashes.

fallbacks.title: Search fallbacks
fallbacks.description: Choose the web actions Volt shows when local results are not confident enough.
fallbacks.rememberHistoryDesc: Allow Volt to keep your web queries on this device. Disabled by default.

validation.required: A label and target URL are required.
validation.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

editor.label: Result label
editor.targetHelp: Use {query} for the URL-encoded query or {rawQuery} for the original text.

brave.title: Brave Search API
brave.description: Optional provider for live web results and suggestions inside Volt.
brave.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Brave Search API key
brave.storageNotice: Stored in the operating system credential vault. The key is never written to your settings file.
brave.disabledWithoutKey: Live Brave results stay disabled until a key is saved.
brave.saveBeforeTest: Save the new key before testing it.
brave.confirmDelete: Delete the saved Brave Search API key?

status.valid: The saved API key is valid.
status.invalid: The saved API key could not be validated.

fallbacks.listDesc: Shown in this order when a search finds nothing. Turn each one on or off, reorder, edit or delete it.

clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.infoText: Clipboard History stores your recent clipboard entries for quick access. Use
clipboard.infoTextSuffix: followed by your search term to find past clipboard items.
clipboard.retentionDesc: How long clipboard entries are retained.
clipboard.disabledAppsDesc: Clipboard changes from these apps are not recorded.
clipboard.appExecutableHint: Enter the application executable name without .exe (for example, 1password). A pasted .exe suffix is removed automatically.
clipboard.pluginNote: Turns the cb search command on or off. Capture and privacy settings below stay available so you can still control what is recorded.

applications.title: Applications
applications.aliasesHotkeysDesc: Give an installed app a short alias or a global hotkey, or turn it off.

shell.title: Shell Commands
shell.infoText: Execute shell commands directly from Volt with the
shell.infoTextSuffix: prefix. Output streams in real-time with ANSI color support.
shell.enabledDesc: Allow running commands with the > prefix
shell.defaultShellDesc: Override the system shell (leave empty for default: cmd on Windows, sh on Unix)
shell.workingDirDesc: Default directory for commands (leave empty for home directory)
shell.timeoutDesc: Maximum time before a command is killed
shell.historySizeDesc: Maximum number of commands to remember
shell.clearHistoryDesc: Remove all saved shell command history

snippetExpansion.title: Snippets
snippetExpansion.infoText: In-app snippets are triggered by typing the
snippetExpansion.infoTextSuffix: prefix in Volt's search bar. The setting below is a separate, global mechanism that expands the same triggers system-wide, in any application.
snippetExpansion.enabledDesc: Expand snippet triggers anywhere on Windows, not just in Volt
snippetExpansion.maxTriggerLenDesc: Longest trigger the system-wide watcher tracks, in characters
snippetExpansion.excludedAppsDesc: Global expansion never fires while one of these apps is focused
snippetExpansion.excludedAppsPrompt: Enter executable name to exclude (e.g. keepass):
snippetExpansion.globalDesc: Expand the same triggers in any application, not only in Volt. Opt-in.

snippetsManager.title: Your Snippets
snippetsManager.subtitle: Manage the triggers and content used by in-app and global expansion
snippetsManager.empty: No snippets yet. Create your first one.
snippetsManager.confirmDelete: Delete the snippet "{{trigger}}"? This cannot be undone.
snippetsManager.triggerHint: Include the prefix you'll type to expand it, e.g. ";sig"
snippetsManager.contentPlaceholder: Text to insert when the trigger is typed
snippetsManager.newDesc: Create a text shortcut with a trigger, its content and optional variables.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect your accounts to enable features from external extensions. Your tokens are encrypted and stored securely locally.
integrations.tokenSavedSecure: Token saved securely and ready to use
integrations.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to remove the {{service}} token?
integrations.invalidToken: Invalid {{service}} token. Check the token and try again.

security.title: Your tokens are safe
security.neverTransmitted: Used for the services you connect

github.description: Search repositories, issues, PRs, and gists from Volt
github.name: GitHub

notion.description: Access and search your Notion workspace from Volt
notion.name: Notion

integrations.statusErrorDesc: Stored credentials could not be checked. Try again to view your connections.
integrations.tokenDesc: Paste a token to connect without OAuth. It is stored in the operating system keyring.
integrations.tokenActionsDesc: Test the saved token, replace it or remove it.

account.title: Account
account.signInDescription: Sign in to sync settings and unlock premium features.
account.statusDesc: The account Volt is signed in with and its plan.
account.sessionDesc: Sign in to sync settings and unlock premium features, or sign out of this device.

notes.title: Notes
notes.headline: Markdown notes with full-text search
notes.tagline: Capture, search and organize notes stored on this device.
notes.trashDesc: Deleted notes stay in trash and can be restored from the Notes window. Empty the trash to permanently remove them.

cmd.createDesc: Start a fresh note in the editor

notes.loadFailed: Your notes could not be loaded. Try again.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Configure AI providers to use AI features in Volt and extensions. API keys are stored securely in the OS keyring and never leave your machine.
ai.infoMiddle: . If an extension doesn't configure its own key, it falls back to the global key above. Keys require the

local.title: Local model
local.description: Run models on your machine with Ollama or LM Studio — no API key. Volt connects to your OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
local.modelDesc: Name of the model your local server should use.
local.saveDesc: Save the endpoint and model, or remove the local connection.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Context injected into all AI Chat conversations (not AI Commands)
profile.placeholder: e.g. I'm a senior Rust dev. Prefer idiomatic code, no comments.
profile.contextDesc: Free text sent as context with every AI Chat conversation.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.description: Press a hotkey from any app → Volt runs AI on your clipboard
quickActions.newPrompt: Your custom system prompt here. The clipboard text will be sent as the user message.
quickActions.addDesc: Create a prompt you can run on your clipboard with a global hotkey.

ai.statusErrorDesc: Your provider configuration could not be loaded. Existing keys are unchanged.
ai.statusUnavailable: Try again to view configured providers.
ai.deleteError: The API key could not be removed. Try again.
ai.providerDesc: Global API key, stored in the operating system keyring.

sync.title: Cloud Sync
sync.description: Keep your snippets and quicklinks in sync across all your machines.

premiumBanner.title: Premium feature
premiumBanner.upgradeHint: Upgrade your account to unlock cloud sync.
premiumBanner.loginHint: Log in and upgrade to Premium to use cloud sync.

push.title: Push to cloud
push.description: Upload your local snippets and quicklinks to the cloud. Remote data will be overwritten.

pull.title: Pull from cloud
pull.description: Download cloud data and merge with your local snippets. Quicklinks will be replaced.

feedback.premiumRequired: Upgrade to Premium to use cloud sync.
feedback.notLoggedIn: You need to log in first.

sync.statusErrorDesc: Your account status could not be checked. Try again before syncing.

emoji.primaryActionDesc: Choose what happens when you select an emoji.
emoji.skinToneDesc: Default tone for emoji that support it.
emoji.columnsHint: Number of emoji per row in the picker.
emoji.clearRecentDesc: Forget the emoji you used most. The picker starts over with no suggestions.

launcher.historyDesc: Volt learns from what you launch to rank results. You can start over at any time.
launcher.clearLaunchesDesc: Forget the apps and commands you launched. Suggestions and ranking start from scratch.
launcher.clearFilesDesc: Forget the files you opened from Volt. The file index itself is not changed.
launcher.clearFailed: The history could not be cleared.
launcher.confirmLaunches: Forget everything Volt learned from your launches? This cannot be undone.
launcher.confirmFiles: Forget the list of recently opened files? This cannot be undone.
launcher.rootDesc: What the launcher shows and remembers each time you open it.
launcher.popToRootDesc: Reset the search and the open view when you reopen Volt after this long. "Never" keeps exactly where you left off.
launcher.includeFilesDesc: Search indexed files from the main search bar. Queries with ext:, in:, size: or modified: still search files.
launcher.includeGamesDesc: Show installed games among the root results. Typing game, games or play still finds them.

calculator.infoText: Type an expression, a unit conversion or a date question straight in Volt. Recent results are kept on this device.
calculator.clearHistoryDesc: Delete the recent results stored on this device (the last 50).

games.libraryDesc: Volt scans the game stores installed on this computer.
games.platformsDesc: Game launchers found on this computer and how many games each one holds.
games.rescanDesc: Look for newly installed or removed games now.
games.noPlatforms: No game store detected on this computer.
games.loadFailed: The game stores could not be listed.

extensions.storeDesc: Browse community extensions and manage the ones you installed.

keyboard.escapeBehaviorDesc: What Escape does in the search bar.

escapeOptions.clearThenClose: Clear first, close on the next press

keyboard.escapeSecondaryDesc: Close the Settings and Notes windows with Escape.
keyboard.listNavigationDesc: Extra keys to move through lists, on top of the arrow keys. In the Vim preset the actions menu moves to Ctrl+Shift+K.
keyboard.openSettingsHotkeyDesc: Optional system-wide shortcut. Ctrl+, always works inside the launcher.

systemMonitor.refreshIntervalDesc: How often metrics are sampled and shown. Shorter intervals use slightly more CPU.

timer.durationsDesc: Used by the Pomodoro presets and the Focus Timer view.
timer.longBreakDesc: Longer rest after a full cycle.

windowManagement.gapDesc: Pixels kept around the screen edges and between two snapped windows. 0 keeps windows flush.

quicklinks.usePreferredBrowserDesc: Open http and https quicklinks in the browser chosen in Web Search instead of the system default.
quicklinks.chooseBrowser: No browser is chosen yet: pick one in Web Search settings.
